coordinator_summary: This call represents a critical service failure. The agent demonstrated extremely poor professionalism (2/10) with zero empathy (1/10), dismissing the patient's legitimate need for appointment rescheduling and explicitly stating "Not my problem" when asked for alternative assistance. The patient, by contrast, was exemplary—maintaining respect (9/10), clarity (10/10), and cooperation (10/10) despite the agent's hostility. The core issue remains completely unresolved (2/10), with no next steps provided (1/10). While privacy was appropriately handled (8/10) and no safety risk was introduced, this call requires immediate escalation for agent retraining. The interaction violates basic hospital customer service standards and likely violates institutional service level agreements.
